user.title: Connect to OpenClaw
user.description: Set up OpenClaw as a Home Assistant Assist conversation agent.

data_description.base_url: The OpenClaw OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including scheme, host and port.
data_description.api_key: Optional. Sent as a bearer token. Leave blank if OpenClaw is unauthenticated.
data_description.model: The model or agent OpenClaw should use, for example ha-voice.
data_description.system_prompt: Optional instructions prepended to every conversation.
data_description.timeout: Seconds to wait for OpenClaw (inactivity timeout while streaming).
data_description.verify_tls: Disable only for self-signed certificates on trusted networks.
data_description.verify_connection: Send a tiny request to confirm the URL and token before saving.
